lines.text: Well, {winner} has put a lasting signature on a rivalry that barely had time to introduce itself.
lines.was: Well, {winner} has managed to turn an entire rivalry into a single, decisive signature.

lines.text: I wouldn't blame {loser} for wanting a rematch, but this Showdown isn't taking bookings.
lines.was: Look at {loser} there, already thinking about a rematch that this format simply doesn't offer.

lines.text: That's the beauty of a short Showdown, {winner} gets the glory without the long wait.
Oddly enough, a short contest has given us a conclusion with a remarkably long shelf life.
Quite a finish from {winner}, and the debate has run out of seasons to hide in.
If you saved your best argument for later, I'm afraid the show's already over.
For {loserClub}, it's a brief disappointment, not a verdict on everything that club can do.
Even this panel can agree on the important part, the competition has actually finished.
There goes the whole competition, wrapped up before anyone could ask for a sequel.
Every pundit loves a long-running debate, and {winner} has rather spoiled that business.
Hard to build a comeback when the challenge ends with the opening campaign.
lines.was: Hard to build a comeback when the entire contest ends with the opening campaign.

lines.text: Championships are rarely so compact, which makes that outcome unusually difficult to dilute.
lines.was: Championships are rarely so compact, which makes that result rather difficult to dilute.

lines.text: A runner-up can be disappointed without being diminished, there's plenty of respect on this desk.
Imagine writing a season preview and finding it's also the championship's closing chapter.
lines.was: Imagine writing a season preview and finding it's also the title race's final chapter.

lines.text: Something tells me {winner} won't be requesting a longer format any time soon.
Opening statements rarely become closing arguments, but that's exactly what this format demands.
Here's the trouble with hindsight, it cannot turn a finished Showdown back into an open contest.
lines.was: Here's a result that won't improve with a recount of what might have happened later.

lines.text: I was going to call {winner} efficient, then remembered there's an entire championship at stake.
lines.was: I'd call {winner}'s job efficient, but that scarcely captures the size of the reward.

lines.text: Brief on the calendar, enormous in the memory, this was no minor undertaking.
lines.was: Brief on the calendar, enormous in the memory, this was no minor competition.

lines.text: Anyone promising to grow into this challenge has discovered the schedule was remarkably unforgiving.
lines.was: Anyone promising to grow into this Showdown has discovered the schedule was rather unforgiving.

lines.text: Whatever the pundits predicted, the verdict is considerably more stubborn than our opinions.
lines.was: Whatever the pundits predicted, the final result is considerably more stubborn than our opinions.

lines.text: Long-term plans are rather decorative when the trophy has already found its destination.
Remember, {winnerClub} won't have to defend this result in a later campaign here.
From the opening chapter, {winner} had to make the ending count, and look at that payoff.
lines.was: From the start, {winner} understood that there wasn't another chapter to rescue a poor ending.

lines.text: The phrase 'plenty of time' had no place here, and {winner} made sure of it.
Don't confuse brevity with small stakes, {winner} has earned a very substantial prize.
It's a little embarrassing for the analysts, we've hardly warmed our chairs and there's a champion.
Somewhere in the studio notes is a prediction for next season, completely useless now.
Now {loserClub} has every right to eye another challenge, but this trophy has a settled owner.
lines.was: Now {loserClub} can disagree with the result, but the final standings have their answer.

lines.text: Such a big argument squeezed into a tiny calendar, and somehow the finish still feels complete.
lines.was: Quite extraordinary how much a rivalry can ask of a manager in such a little window.

lines.text: My favourite part is that nobody can hide behind a promise about later improvements.
We talked up this occasion from the outset, and {winnerClub} has justified every minute.
lines.was: We waited for the Showdown, and {winnerClub} has made the wait worthwhile.

lines.text: Careful what you wish for, the short format has given {winner} a lasting headline.
It's a sprint on the calendar, but for {loser} the outcome may linger a good deal longer.
lines.was: It's a sprint on the calendar, but for {loser} the result will linger rather longer.

lines.text: Personally, I'd like another season, but {winner} has every reason to disagree.
Consider the pressure on {winnerClub}, every decision in this campaign had nowhere to hide.
Nothing provisional about this verdict, the Showdown belongs to {winner} outright.
A fair contest, a definite finish, and absolutely no chance of borrowing time from tomorrow.
There is no slow build here, {winnerClub} went straight from contender to champion.
Even with {loser} missing the prize, that title feels properly earned, not simply hurried.
lines.was: Even {loser} will know a short competition demands respect, and this outcome deserves it.

lines.text: That's a whole title settled before the pundits have finished arguing about the opening.
I suspect {winner} rather enjoys a format that doesn't allow anyone to catch up later.
Strange how the shortest format can produce the most definitive conversation in the studio.
All that anticipation, and it ends with {winner} owning the lasting bragging rights.
We can discuss alternatives all night, but {loserClub} knows this particular duel is finished.
lines.was: We can discuss alternatives all night, but {loserClub} knows this particular contest is finished.

lines.text: Not a rehearsal, not a warm-up, this was the complete title race and {winner} won it.
lines.was: Not a rehearsal, not a warm-up, this was the entire competition and {winner} won it.

lines.text: We might expect an encore, yet {winner} has already taken the curtain call.
It's almost rude how quickly the title argument has been settled in {winner}'s favour.
No manager had the luxury of finding form in a later chapter, and that mattered.
I'd wager {loser} would welcome another chance, and that makes this ending all the more decisive.
lines.was: I'd wager {loser} would welcome another chance, which is precisely what makes this final.

lines.text: No unfinished business in this edition, {winnerClub} has put its name on the cover.
lines.was: The story has its ending, and {winnerClub} gets the line everyone wanted to write.

lines.text: When everything rides on a single campaign, {winner} has to be more than merely promising.
You can hear the debate stopping mid-sentence, the answer has done the talking instead.
lines.was: You can hear the debate stopping mid-sentence, the result has done the talking instead.

lines.text: Here's the awkward part for {loser}, there's no subsequent season to change the subject.
We heard plenty about potential, but {winnerClub} has delivered something rather more concrete.
Funny, we gave the preview a long discussion and the actual verdict has stolen the whole show.
lines.was: Funny how a compact competition can leave such a huge space in the trophy conversation.

lines.text: That'll do for {winner}, who has won the whole thing without waiting for a series.
Suggestions for a rematch will be plentiful, but {winner} has already claimed this edition.
lines.was: Somebody will suggest extending the rules, but the decision belongs to {winner} as played.

lines.text: Such a tight schedule left little room for correction, and {winnerClub} made the most of it.
Forget the mileage, {winner} has taken the shortest possible route to the biggest prize.
lines.was: It's not the length of the journey, {winner} has proved, it's who finishes with the prize.

lines.text: Quite an achievement, making a small window feel like the grandest room in the house.
Do spare a thought for {loser}, a worthy rival in an edition with no return visit.
lines.was: Do spare a thought for {loser}, a credible rival in a competition with no return visit.

lines.text: There are no instalments left to sell, which must upset the studio more than {winner}.
Call it instant success if you like, {winnerClub} has earned something that will last.
lines.was: Call it immediate gratification if you like, {winnerClub} can simply call it championship success.

lines.text: Suppose the panel demanded another chance to judge, the closing page would politely disagree.
lines.was: Suppose the panel demanded another chance to judge, the final edition would politely disagree.

lines.text: A campaign may pass quickly, but this championship verdict won't be going anywhere.
lines.was: A season may pass quickly, but this Showdown verdict won't be going anywhere.

lines.text: Quite the advertisement for {winnerClub}, who turned a narrow window into complete success.
For the neutral, more chapters would be lovely, but {winner} has written the ending.
Ask {loserClub} about a sequel and you'll hear why the original ending matters so much.
lines.was: Ask {loserClub} about a sequel and you'll hear why the original result matters so much.

lines.text: There wasn't time to build a legend gradually, so {winner} chose the direct approach.
What a moment for {winnerClub}, a short race carrying the weight of a full championship.
lines.was: What a moment for {winnerClub}, the entire competition compressed into a triumphant conclusion.

lines.text: This isn't an early lead being mistaken for victory, it's the finish itself.
Meanwhile, {loser} can take pride in contesting something whose result mattered immediately.
There's a whistle in the imagination and a full stop on the page, all at once.
You'd normally ask about the next round, but the answer is right there in the trophy.
In the end, {winnerClub} didn't need a longer argument, just a better answer.
Pressure does funny things to predictions, but {winner} has made the outcome wonderfully straightforward.
lines.was: The stakes felt concentrated because they were, and {winner} handled that wonderfully.

lines.text: The trophy won't be waiting through future campaigns, {winner} has earned the right to enjoy it now.
lines.was: There'll be no late-season revival in this edition, {winner} has already secured the crown.

lines.text: I'd forgotten how ruthless a short schedule can be until {winnerClub} made it look simple.
All roads led to this conclusion, even if there was barely any road at all.
lines.was: All roads led to this verdict, even if there was barely any road at all.

lines.text: You'll forgive {winner} for not proposing extra chapters to make the story more dramatic.
As for {loserClub}, the next rivalry can offer hope, but this trophy has its owner.
I'll admit it, the panel wanted a saga, but {winner} has handed us a final chapter.
lines.was: I'll admit it, we've spent longer debating the format than {winner} needed to win it.

lines.text: Finishing fast is usually a compliment, but here it comes with the entire championship.
Enough of the hypothetical comebacks, this edition has reached its last page.
lines.was: Enough of the hypothetical comebacks, this edition has reached its final page.

lines.text: Maybe {loser} wanted a marathon, but the contract was a sprint and the finish is official.
Under that pressure, {winner} has managed the hardest trick, being ready at once.
No suspense can be carried into another chapter, the winner has already been decided.
lines.was: No suspense can be carried into another campaign, the winner has already been decided.

lines.text: Surely {winnerClub} will keep this particular setup close to its heart for a while.
lines.was: Surely {winnerClub} will keep this particular format close to its heart for a while.

lines.text: Respect to {loser}, because an outright ending can sting even when the contest was worth playing.
lines.was: Well played to {loser}, because losing the title doesn't erase the courage of competing.

lines.text: The studio could fill an evening with possibilities, but {winner} needs only the decision.
lines.was: The studio could fill an evening with possibilities, but {winner} needs only the result.

lines.text: I'd say {winnerClub} timed it perfectly, except there was only this chance to take.
Not much room for a slow start, yet {winner} has emerged with the ultimate prize.
lines.was: Not much room for a slow start, yet {winner} has emerged with the entire prize.

lines.text: If you're {loser}, the hardest part is knowing the finish has genuinely arrived.
For those who wanted a drawn-out saga, the closing credits have arrived early.
Both managers had the same short runway, and {winner} made the champion's landing.
Try telling {winner} that this title needs another chapter, I think you'll get a grin.
Some campaigns open a debate, this result has closed the championship in emphatic fashion.
lines.was: Some seasons open a debate, this edition has closed the Showdown in emphatic fashion.

lines.text: Beneath that brisk conclusion sits a serious achievement, {winner} took the opportunity that couldn't come back.
lines.was: Behind that quick conclusion lies a serious achievement, {winner} took the chance that mattered.

lines.text: It's settled, it's deserved, and {winnerClub} can put the whole season on the mantelpiece.
